description: A light wooden tabletop is in front of you, with a crumpled white T‑shirt near the center and a red cloth draped in the back. The left hand reaches forward and then both hands move in to grasp the shirt as a two-hand object, lifting and spreading it out flat before folding it in sections: the hands slide and smooth the fabric, fold the bottom up, fold one side over toward the other, then fold again into a smaller rectangle and release it neatly on the table.
